grammar.label: be going to — plans and intentions
grammar.form: am / is / are going to + base verb

explanation.en: Use be going to for something you have already decided to do.
explanation.uz: Allaqachon qaror qilingan ish uchun 'be going to' ishlatiladi.

grammar.positive_example: I am going to study at university.
grammar.negative_example: I going to study at university.

l1_notes.uz: 'be' tushib qolmasin. Nutqda 'going to' ko'pincha /ˈɡʌnə/ deb aytiladi.

grammar.label: be going to — predictions from evidence
grammar.meaning: a prediction based on what you can see now

explanation.en: Use going to when you can see it coming: Look at those clouds — it's going to rain.
explanation.uz: Hozirgi dalilga asoslangan bashorat: Look at those clouds — it's going to rain.

grammar.positive_example: Look out! You're going to fall.

l1_notes.uz: Ko'rinib turgan dalil bo'lsa — going to; shunchaki fikr bo'lsa — will (A2 da).

grammar.label: present continuous for fixed arrangements
grammar.form: be + -ing with a future time expression
grammar.meaning: an arrangement already fixed with another person

explanation.en: Use the present continuous for arrangements with a time and place already fixed.
explanation.uz: Vaqti va joyi allaqachon kelishilgan rejalar uchun present continuous ishlatiladi.

grammar.positive_example: I'm meeting Aziz at six tomorrow.
grammar.negative_example: I meet Aziz at six tomorrow.

l1_notes.uz: Kelasi zamon ma'nosida hozirgi davomiy zamon ishlatilishi o'zbek tilida g'alati tuyuladi — kalendardagi yozuv deb tasavvur qiling.
